name: Hidegség (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal seal of Hidegség: a green shield with a red grapevine and a white boat within a red ring inscribed HIDEGSÉG 1274 2000.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: seal of Hidegség with green shield in a red ring
